acolyte.name: Acolyte
acolyte.desc: You devoted your life to serving a temple, studying sacred rites and the doctrines of a deity. Your spirit is guided by faith.
acolyte.equipA: Holy symbol, prayer book, 3 sticks of incense, vestments, common clothes, 15 GP

artisan.name: Artisan
artisan.desc: You learned the secrets of a craft and became a guild member. Your hands can create objects of value.
artisan.equipA: Artisan's tools, 2 pouches, traveler's clothes, 15 GP

charlatan.name: Charlatan
charlatan.desc: You have always had a talent for convincing people of anything. With a smile and the right words you can be anyone.
charlatan.equipA: Forgery kit, costume, fine clothes, 15 GP

criminal.name: Criminal
criminal.desc: You lived in the shadows of society, honing your skills in crime. You know who buys and sells secrets.
criminal.equipA: Thieves' tools, crowbar, 2 daggers, common clothes with hood, 16 GP

entertainer.name: Entertainer
entertainer.desc: You spent your youth performing before audiences, mastering music, dance, or the performance arts.
entertainer.equipA: Musical instrument, 2 costumes, mirror, perfume, traveler's clothes, 11 GP

farmer.name: Farmer
farmer.desc: You grew up working the land and earned your living through sweat and toil. Your strength and resilience come from your roots.
farmer.equipA: Scythe, carpenter's tools, healer's kit, iron pot, shovel, traveler's clothes, 30 GP

guard.name: Guard
guard.desc: You served as a guard in a city, fortress, or noble court. You are trained to watch over and protect.
guard.equipA: Spear, light crossbow, 20 bolts, musical instrument, fine clothes, 5 GP

guide.name: Guide
guide.desc: You spent years exploring wilderness, drawing maps and leading travelers through uncharted lands.
guide.equipA: Shortbow, 20 arrows, cartographer's tools, bedroll, rope (50 ft), traveler's clothes, 3 GP

hermit.name: Hermit
hermit.desc: You lived in isolation, meditating and studying the mysteries of the world. Solitude gave you deep inner understanding.
hermit.equipA: Quarterstaff, herbalism kit, bedroll, book (philosophy), common clothes, 16 GP

merchant.name: Merchant
merchant.desc: You made money buying and selling goods at markets and fairs. You can spot value in anything and negotiate with anyone.
merchant.equipA: Navigator's tools, 2 pouches, traveler's clothes, 22 GP

noble.name: Noble
noble.desc: You were raised in a high-ranking family, surrounded by wealth, power, and court intrigue. Your name opens many doors.
noble.equipA: Gaming set, fine clothes, signet ring, scroll of pedigree, 25 GP

sage.name: Sage
sage.desc: You spent your formative years traveling among manors and monasteries, studying books and scrolls and learning the history of the multiverse.
sage.equipA: Quarterstaff, calligrapher's supplies, book (history), parchment (8 sheets), robe, 8 GP

sailor.name: Sailor
sailor.desc: You spent years on the open sea, learning the secrets of navigation and weathering storms and pirates. The sea is your home.
sailor.equipA: Dagger, navigator's tools, rope (50 ft), traveler's clothes, 20 GP

scribe.name: Scribe
scribe.desc: You learned to read, write, and copy documents in a notarial office or library. The pen is your weapon.
scribe.equipA: Calligrapher's supplies, fine clothes, lamp, 3 oil flasks, parchment (12 sheets), 23 GP

soldier.name: Soldier
soldier.desc: You fought as part of an army or militia. Military discipline and the experience of battle forged you.
soldier.equipA: Spear, shortbow, 20 arrows, gaming set, traveler's clothes, 14 GP

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer
wayfarer.desc: You lived on the margins of society, learning to survive on little and move through the shadows of great cities.
wayfarer.equipA: Dagger, thieves' tools, gaming set, bedroll, 2 costumes, 16 GP
